optionNotes: Two 5-year renewal options (Fourth Amendment), each on ≥6 months' notice. Rent: First Option (3/1/2034–2/28/2039) $33.28/SF ($324,280.32); Second Option (3/1/2039–2/29/2044) $36.60/SF ($356,630.40).

percentageRent.value: 2% of Sales above a natural breakpoint. The 'Sales Base' (breakpoint) = the fixed minimum rent for the calendar year ÷ 2% (so it floats up with each rent step). Prorated for partial calendar years.

exclusives.description: COSMETICS exclusive (Lease §7.10): no other premises in the Shopping Center (except Ulta's own premises, 'Retail F', and the 2,470 SF Bath Works space in 'Retail G' and its successors) may have a PRIMARY business of selling cosmetics, fragrances or hair-care products. Incidental sales by other stores are allowed, and beauty-salon operations are not prohibited. Runs with the land.

coTenancy.value: Ulta has a co-tenancy provision (expressly referenced in Fourth Amendment §7 as an example of a 'co-tenancy failure'). The lease's 'Inducement Tenants' (the original anchor basis) were King Soopers, Homeplace, OfficeMax and Just For Feet. The detailed ongoing co-tenancy remedy terms reside in the base lease / Third Amendment and were not fully extracted in this pass — flagged below.

narrative: Ulta Beauty (Ulta Salon, Cosmetics & Fragrance, Inc.; store #70) occupies 9,744 SF (Suite 30) at University Hills, Denver under a 8/11/1997 lease that commenced 11/19/1998. The controlling document is the 6/28/2023 Fourth Amendment, which extends the term to 2/28/2034 at $27.50/SF stepping to $30.25/SF, with two 5-year options at $33.28 and $36.60/SF running to 2/29/2044 — all matching the April-2026 rent roll. Ulta pays 2% percentage rent over a natural breakpoint, holds a cosmetics/fragrance/hair-care exclusive (carve-outs for Retail F and the small Bath Works space), and has broad assignment rights (collateral/merger/affiliate transfers and ≥10-store portfolio sales to a $50M-net-worth buyer, no consent). The Fourth Amendment also grants Ulta a $270,000 renovation allowance if it remodels by 10/1/2026 — a KPR landlord obligation to track. No tenant guaranty. The full 17-document folder was enumerated; the controlling economics and key business terms are source-verified, with some qualitative base-lease clauses left for a deeper pass to conserve bandwidth.
